stem.text: Two experiments are carried out to study the reaction between zinc and sulfuric acid.

rows: Small lumps of zinc are added to excess dilute sulfuric acid.
The reaction is carried out at a lower temperature and with one other change.

stem.text: Both experiments produce the same total volume of gas and are completed in the same time.
What is the second change made in experiment 2?

B.text: A greater mass of zinc is added.

C.text: A greater volume of sulfuric acid is added.

D.text: Larger lumps of zinc are used.
